text: A woman walked out to a well at noon — the hottest, emptiest hour of the day.
You need to understand what that hour means.
Women drew their water in the cool of the morning, together.
It was where the talk happened.
She came at noon because of the talk.
Five marriages behind her, living now with a man who wasn't her husband — and the whole town knew every chapter.
Noon was the hour with nobody in it.
